lines.x: Asian government bonds posted strong weekly performance led by Indian sovereign debt, with India's benchmark 2036 bond yield falling about 22 basis points for the week to 7.1973%.
Trading in Electronic Gold Receipts on the National Stock Exchange of India reached a record 227,000 units during Dhanteras as investors embraced formal gold trading platforms.

The Indian rupee appreciated 52 paise to close at 93.89 per US dollar, supported by declining US Treasury yields, softening crude oil prices, and foreign capital inflows into domestic financial markets.
Tata Chemicals reported its Q2 FY27 financial results, showing an 8% increase in revenue alongside contracting profit margins.
